business_summary: Sagami Holdings Corporation develops and operates a chain of Japanese and noodle restaurants in Japan, Vietnam, and Italy. It operates restaurants under the Sagami, Ajino Mingei, Don Don An, Aiso-Ya, CHOSUKE, NIDAIME CHOSUKE, SUIZAN, JINJIN, SAGAMI, BINMUGI, BUBUKA, Sagami Issha, SAGAMI VIETNAM, and SAGAMI Milano Centrale names. The company is also involved in the management of restaurants; manufacturing, processing, and sale of noodles; franchise business; management of overseas outlets; management of the Tenobe Udon specialty restaurant, Ajino-Mingei restaurant, and other specialty restaurant chains; manufacture, processing, sale, and import/export of ingredients, food and restaurant-related materials, cut vegetables, sauces and soups, and delicatessen; provision of sales support and business promotion services; and product development work. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
